documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Held On October 30, 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Board Meeting Intimation for Meeting To Be Held On October 30, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management reported a 3% growth in reported revenues for FY19, or 13% adjusted for domestic billing methodology changes, alongside significant margin expansion and a more than doubling of profit after tax. The company experienced strong summer demand and international revenue expansion at the start of FY20, while anticipating stable costs through Q2 and planned price increases in the second half due to higher milk prices. Management guides to regular capital expenditure of Rs. 30-35 crore during the year and expects to deliver double digit growth with higher international contributions leading to margin expansion. Vadilal Industries reported strong financial performance for Q3 and nine months of FY19, driven by robust growth in both domestic and international revenues as well as expanding gross and EBITDA margins.

guidance.claim: The company expects to spend Rs. 30-35 crore in regular capital expenditure during the year.
guidance.quote: We continue to incur regular capital expenditure and expect to spend Rs. 30-35 crore during the year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver double digit growth with higher international contribution leading to margin expansion.
guidance.quote: We also expect to deliver double digit growth with higher contribution from international business leading to margin expansion.

guidance.claim: Management expects another good year in FY20 by leveraging the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.
guidance.quote: Going forward, we see another good year in FY20 as we leverage the Vadilal brand for ongoing growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions and an extended winter.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues grew by 54% in FY19 and crossed the $20 million milestone driven by strong demand from the Indian diaspora in the U.S. and other geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues continued to deliver encouraging expansion to cross the $ 20 million milestone, on the back of 54% revenue growth during FY19.

demand_outlook.claim: The company started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: We have started FY20 with double digit growth in the summer season and 25% revenue expansion in international business.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic business growth is now reverting to historical trends after being temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic business growth, temporarily impacted by recent changes in operating environment and consumption spending, is now reverting to historical trends

demand_outlook.claim: Latent demand for quality Indian products is driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Latent demand for quality Indian products driving strong volume growth in US ice cream sales

demand_outlook.claim: During Q2, the company expanded ice cream volumes by 6.9%, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: During Q2, we have continued our strong business momentum to expand ice cream volumes by 6.9%, driven by 6% domestic volume growth and 37% expansion in the international business.

demand_outlook.claim: International revenues contributed 32% to the turnover during Q2.
demand_outlook.quote: International revenues contributed 32% to the turnover during Q2 and continue to expand rapidly with Vadilal ice cream and processed foods products finding positive demand pull from the Indian diaspora in the US and other key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Management maintains a positive business outlook driven by a better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector, and continued traction in international business.
demand_outlook.quote: Going forward, we maintain our positive business outlook – better environment for consumption, demand shift to the organized sector and continued traction in international business.

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY20 is approximately Rs. 30 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Estimated capex for FY 20 at ~ Rs. 30 crore

capex_expansion.claim: No major capital expenditure is anticipated on capacity enhancement.
capex_expansion.quote:  No major capital expenditure anticipated on capacity enhancement

capex_expansion.claim: Estimated capex for FY 19 is around Rs. 35 crore.
capex_expansion.quote:  Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year due to volume growth, benign raw material prices, and higher international realizations.
margins_costs.quote: Gross margin expanded by over 600 basis points last year on the back of volume growth, benign raw material prices and larger contribution from international operations, where realizations are significantly higher.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, driven by U.S. operations with a base of over 50 employees.
margins_costs.quote: Cost of people resources increased significantly last year, with a large contribution from U.S. operations that now have a base of over 50 employees.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, EBITDA margin increased by almost 400 basis points and profit after tax more than doubled.

margins_costs.claim: Stable costs are covered till Q2 based on raw material purchase and inventory position.
margins_costs.quote: Based on our raw material purchase and inventory position, we have visibility of stable costs covered till Q2.

margins_costs.claim: Management will look to increase prices in the second half of the year as milk prices are at higher levels now.
margins_costs.quote: As milk prices are at higher levels now, we will look to increasing prices in the second half of the year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have continued to expand – gross margin increased to 50% in Q3 compared to 40% in the same quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: On a nine-month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.
margins_costs.quote: On nine month basis, gross margin expanded from 43% to 49%.

margins_costs.claim: The company has clear visibility of input costs for the upcoming summer season having closed key supply arrangements.
margins_costs.quote: Having already closed key supply arrangements for the upcoming summer season, we have clear visibility of input costs and expect strong contribution from sales.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin increased by over ~1,000 bps during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Margins have improved significantly during the quarter – gross margin increased by over 600 bps to 44.4% and EBITDA margin by over ~1,000 bps.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices continue to be subdued for the next season, which should benefit margins.
margins_costs.quote: We have been engaging with raw material suppliers for the next season and prices continue to be subdued, which should benefit margins.

orders_capacity.claim: Total production capacity has been expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years.
orders_capacity.quote:  Capacity expanded from 270,000 liters per day to 380,000 liters per day over the past few years

orders_capacity.claim: Total production capacity across facilities stands at 380,000 liters per day for ice cream and 33,000 kgs per day for processed foods.
orders_capacity.quote:
Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh 150,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005
Dharampur, Gujarat 33,000 kgs per day Processed foods ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6
Pundhra, Gujarat 230,000 liters per day Ice cream ISO-22000:2005 and BRC : Issue 6

capital_allocation.claim: The company reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduce the cost of debt.
capital_allocation.quote: o Reconstituted outstanding debt to increase long tenure loans and reduced cost of debt

capital_allocation.claim: Cash accretion from the business and working capital improvements allow continued debt rationalization.
capital_allocation.quote: However, cash accretion from the business and improvements in working capital allow us to continue debt rationalization as per plan and interest expenses have been decreasing accordingly.

risks_headwinds.claim: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions extending the winter till the end of March.
risks_headwinds.quote: Domestic business saw weakness in Q4 due to exceptionally severe weather conditions that extended the winter till the end of March this year and impacted the consumption of ice cream in many of our core markets.

management_commitments.claim: Estimated capex for FY 19 was set at approximately Rs. 35 crore.
management_commitments.quote:  Estimated capex for FY 19 at ~ Rs. 35 crore
